claims.text: Five Australians were confirmed safe following the Nepal floods, reducing the number of unaccounted-for Australian citizens from 43 to 38.
Australia's Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade received nearly 800 calls regarding the Nepal floods and dispatched 18 personnel to Nepal.
The flash flood began in Tibet on August 26, 2026, when a catastrophic collapse of rock and glacial ice sent water and debris through the Bhote Koshi and Trishuli river systems into Nepal.
Nepal's National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority reported 987 bodies recovered, 3,916 people missing, and 11,814 rescued as of Tuesday morning, September 1.
More than 600 hydropower workers were feared trapped underground in tunnels north of Bidur after the disaster.
Africa Disaster Relief launched a search for six South Africans who went missing in the floods along the border between Nepal and China.
Rescuers in Nepal prioritized the search for at least 900 workers missing from 12 hydropower projects.
India's Ministry of External Affairs reported that 163 Indian nationals had been rescued from Nepal and 151 Indian nationals had left China as of September 1.
An Indian tunnel rescue team established a foothold in hydropower tunnels in Chilime using improvised floats and innovative methods.
By Tuesday evening, September 1, the death toll in Nepal reached 1,050 with around 4,000 people missing, including nearly 600 foreigners from 39 countries.
India dispatched a consignment of 37.5 tonnes of relief material, medicines, and food packets to Nepal, bringing total Indian emergency aid to 47.5 tonnes.
India's GDP grew at 7.8% in the April-June quarter, which Prime Minister Narendra Modi cited while praising economic resilience.
The unit value of gold imports to India moderated to $2.8 per kg, 47% higher than a year earlier, down from $3.5 per kg in June.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the 26th Shanghai Cooperation Organisation summit in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan, on September 1, 2026, urging members to dismantle terrorist ecosystems.
Pakistan assumed the role of Shanghai Cooperation Organisation chair for the 2026-2027 term.
The Bishkek Declaration issued at the SCO summit called for an inclusive government in Taliban-ruled Afghanistan and expressed concern over the conflict in West Asia.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi held a brief exchange with Chinese President Xi Jinping and a bilateral meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Bishkek.
Trade between India and Russia rose from around $13 billion in 2021 to nearly $60 billion in 2025, largely driven by Indian imports of Russian crude oil.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi stated at the SCO summit that the crisis in West Asia must be resolved through dialogue and diplomacy rather than on the battlefield.
SCO leaders adopted joint initiatives on combating drug addiction, biodiversity conservation, and creating the SCO Green Technology Corridor for 2026-2030.
In a video message from Kyrgyzstan, Prime Minister Narendra Modi repeated his appeal for citizens to avoid foreign vacations, destination weddings abroad, and non-essential gold purchases.
India's GDP growth of 7.8% in the April-June quarter surpassed the Reserve Bank of India's forecast of 7%.
